points.en: Quasi-judicial authority created by RBI under Section 35A of Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
points.hi: Quasi-judicial authority created by RBI under Section 35A of Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

points.en: Objective: Redressal of customer grievances against deficiency in banking services.
points.hi: Objective: Redressal of customer grievances against deficiency in banking services.

points.en: Scope: Covers all commercial banks, regional rural banks, and scheduled primary co-operative banks.
points.hi: Scope: Covers all commercial banks, regional rural banks, and scheduled primary co-operative banks.

points.en: Process: Free of cost; complainant must first approach the bank; if no response within 30 days, can approach Ombudsman.
points.hi: Process: Free of cost; complainant must first approach the bank; if no response within 30 days, can approach Ombudsman.

points.en: Appellate Authority: Deputy Governor of RBI.
points.hi: Appellate Authority: Deputy Governor of RBI.

explanation.en: C: Customer complaint, A: Approach bank first, R: Redressal by Ombudsman, E: Escalation to Appellate Authority.
explanation.hi: C: Customer complaint, A: Approach bank first, R: Redressal by Ombudsman, E: Escalation to Appellate Authority.

misconception.en: Banking Ombudsman is a court of law.
misconception.hi: Banking Ombudsman is a court of law.

correction.en: It is an alternative dispute resolution mechanism, not a court.
correction.hi: It is an alternative dispute resolution mechanism, not a court.

fiveFacts.en: Covers deficiency in service, not policy decisions.
fiveFacts.hi: Covers deficiency in service, not policy decisions.

fiveFacts.en: No fee is charged for filing a complaint.
fiveFacts.hi: No fee is charged for filing a complaint.

fiveFacts.en: Appellate authority is the RBI Deputy Governor.
fiveFacts.hi: Appellate authority is the RBI Deputy Governor.

fiveFacts.en: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (2021) merged three previous schemes.
fiveFacts.hi: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (2021) merged three previous schemes.

threeTraps.en: Assuming it covers all non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) without exception.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming it covers all non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) without exception.

threeTraps.en: Thinking the Ombudsman can override RBI monetary policy.
threeTraps.hi: Thinking the Ombudsman can override RBI monetary policy.

threeTraps.en: Believing there is a court fee for filing.
threeTraps.hi: Believing there is a court fee for filing.

meaning.en: 30 days to wait for bank response, 30 days to appeal, 30 days for resolution.
meaning.hi: 30 days to wait for bank response, 30 days to appeal, 30 days for resolution.
